thread:
Michelle: Quick sync: we need to finalize the Cinder Labs advocate vignette this week — interview + quote + localization for EU/APAC + webinar mention. Embargo target: Tue May 14. Who's onable for legal sign-off + transcript redline?
Rajesh: I have the draft transcript uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/xxx. Key quote needs sign-off: 'Redwood helped us cut inference cost by 60% while halving p99 latency' — can legal greenlight that stat?
Oliver: I'll review. Need backup data and permission to include the cost % from Cinder's finance. Also check IP for the 'halving p99' phrasing — sounds riskier. @Michelle pls ping the customer for explicit data permission.
Lina: I'll prep hero image options and mobile-optimized assets. Do we need localized screenshots (fr/de/ja)?
Ben: Cinder's ok with FR/DE, flagged JA as 'internal review'. I'll nudge them. Also: sales wants a short 2-sentence pitch and a 'high-intent' CTA that routes inbound leads to the Dedicated team.
Michelle: Great. @Ben can you own CTAs and routing? We'll set inbound lead routing to sales@redwood.com and tag 'cs:dedicated' in HubSpot. Also we need a 30-min webinar tie-in: proposed panel w/ Cinder + product PM (June 1). Thoughts?
Rajesh: Panel works. For the launch blog, I'm proposing a 300–400 word benchmark callout: throughput x tokens/sec, latency p50/p95, cost per 1M tokens. Need confirm metrics from eng. @Oliver any legal embargo constraints for webinar speakers?
Oliver: Embargo should be same as launch unless customer requests otherwise. For speaker names/biographies we'll need signed consent form. I'll send over the standard release template.
deploy-bot: Reminder: content embargo set for 2026-05-14T09:00Z (pending approval).
Lina: Design note: for localization, we'll hand off strings to translation vendor. Need final copy by EOD Friday. @Rajesh are there any idiomatic lines that can't be translated? e.g., '1-click scaling'
Rajesh: I'll mark those. Also need one shortened quote variant for social (<=140 chars). Suggest: 'Redwood cut our inference cost 60% and improved latency — Cinder Labs' — is that ok?
Oliver: Short quote ok if we remove specific % unless customer confirms. Otherwise need explicit permission.
Ben: I'll get confirmation on the percent tonight. Also suggest we add a 'bench highlights' image for the blog and a CSV of raw numbers for folks who want to dig in.
Michelle: Plan: Ben to get percent permission + speaker consent by Thu. Oliver to send release template today. Rajesh to finalize copy + social variant. Lina to prep assets + localized strings. Marketing to schedule webinar draft invite and A/B subject lines. I'll update the launch checklist and share a final runbook.
Rajesh: One more ask: can Eng provide command used for benchmarking so readers can reproduce? Something like: ```bash
make run-bench MODEL=gptq-seqlen250 BATCH=8
```
Alex: I can provide reproducible command and config. Will attach perf CSV and notes on environment (A100 80GB, mixed-precision, batching strategy).
Ben: Routing note: after publish, set HubSpot workflow: page view of blog -> sales alert + create MQL if company size > 50 & page time >1min. I can draft.
Michelle: :thumbsup: OK. timeline check: if approvals clear by Thu EOD, we publish Tue + webinar June 1. If legal delays, push webinar 1 week. Any blocking items?
Oliver: Blocker: need Cinder finance email confirmation on the 60% cost reduction. If not received, we can pivot to 'significant cost and latency improvements' wording.
Ben: Customer legal is back tomorrow. I'll escalate if no reply by noon.
Rajesh: I'll prep two headline variations for A/B: 1) 'How Cinder Labs cut LLM inference costs by 60%' 2) 'How Cinder Labs sped up inference and lowered costs' — choose based on legal ok.
Lina: Also: please attach headshot + company logo vector to the drive. I'll make an accessible alt-text for assets.
Michelle: Perfect. I'll update thread with final checklist. Thanks all.
